title: Volume of a Hemispherical Shell Region
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Describe the region in R^3 defined by 1 <= x^2 + y^2 + z^2 <= 9 and z >= 0, and compute its total volume.

steps.title: Geometric Interpretation of Region
steps.explanation: The inequalities describe an upper hemispherical shell bounded by concentric spheres of radii 1 and 3 in the half-space z >= 0.

steps.title: Calculate Volume of Hemispherical Shell
steps.explanation: Subtract volume of inner hemisphere from outer hemisphere.
